text: {"findings":[{"resource_address":"azurerm_network_security_rule.seed","doc_id":"POL-002","attribute":"source_address_prefix","title":"azurerm_network_security_rule.seed allows SSH on port \"22\" from the internet because the source is \"0.0.0.0/0\", which exposes an admin port publicly.","suggestion":"Restrict the source address to a private range, VPN, or bastion host instead of \"0.0.0.0/0\".","breaks_standard":true}]}
